@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Add AgentRequestSpan: a server span for each request that the agent sends'
+---
+## What
+
+Add one helper that opens a `.server` span for a request or notification that the agent sends to the client. The span starts in the trace context that the agent put in the `_meta` of the message. Today, trace context goes out only (`ClientRequestSpan`); no code reads it on the way in.
+
+Spec rule (https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/v2/extensibility): "The following root-level keys in `_meta` SHOULD be reserved for W3C trace context ... `traceparent`, `tracestate`, `baggage`." FoundationModelsACP has no tracing code, so this package must make the span.
+
+Files:
+- New: `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Telemetry/AgentRequestSpan.swift`
+- Modify: `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Telemetry/ACPClientTelemetry.swift`
+
+Approach:
+- `enum AgentRequestSpan` (internal) with `static func run<Output>(method:sessionId:meta:tracer:logger:_ body: (any Span) async -> Output) async -> Output`. Model it on `ClientRequestSpan.run(method:sessionId:meta:parent:tracer:logger:metricsFactory:_:)` in `ClientRequestSpan.swift:168`. Use `TracedCall.run` of FoundationModelsExtras with `ofKind: .server`.
+- Parent: `ClientRequestSpan.ParentContext(extractingFrom: meta, tracer:)` (`TracedClientMessage.swift:78`). When `meta` holds no valid `traceparent`, use `ParentContext.current`.
+- Attributes: `rpc.method` and `session.id` (existing keys). The body gets the span, so a caller can set the outcome attributes.
+- Add to `ACPClientTelemetry`:
+  - `SpanName.agentRequest = prefix + "agent.request"`
+  - `AttributeKey.outcome = "acp.response.outcome"`
+  - `AttributeKey.routed = "acp.request.routed"` (Bool)
+  - `enum OutcomeValue` with `selected`, `cancelled`, `accept`, `decline`, `matched` and `unmatched`.
+  - `enum AgentMethod` with the wire names `session/request_permission`, `elicitation/create` and `elicitation/complete`, taken from `MethodTable.generated.swift` in FoundationModelsACP.
+- Rule 4: no attribute holds a title, a description, an option name, a message, a URL or form content.
+- The helper records no metrics. This task adds spans only.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `AgentRequestSpan.run` opens one span with name `FoundationModelsACPClient.agent.request` and kind `.server`.
+- [ ] When `meta` holds a valid `traceparent`, the span has the same trace id as that value, and its parent span id is the parent id of that value.
+- [ ] When `meta` holds no `traceparent` or an invalid one, the span starts in the context of the running task, and the call does not fail.
+- [ ] The span holds `rpc.method`, and `session.id` only when a session id is given.
+- [ ] Each new name is in `ACPClientTelemetry.swift` only. No other source file has the name as a string literal.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Telemetry/AgentRequestSpanTests.swift`: use the in-memory tracer of `TelemetryTestSupport` (as `ClientRequestSpanTests.swift` does). Test the span name and kind, the parent from a valid `traceparent`, the fallback for a missing value and for an invalid value, and the attributes with and without a session id.
+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Telemetry/ACPClientTelemetryVocabularyTests.swift` to cover the new names, including the prefix rule.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "AgentRequestSpan|ACPClientTelemetryVocabulary"`. All tests pass.
+- [ ] Run `swift test`. All tests pass and the build has no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then write the code that makes them pass. #telemetry
\ No newline at end of file

Plan: make `ClientRequestSpan.enterMetadata` internal and move the two attribute writes into one internal helper that both spans call, so that no copy exists. This touches `ClientRequestSpan.swift` a little more than the method names; the reason is the duplication rule.
